name: Carbon assimilation cycle in photosynthesis
description: A Berkeley team proposed a cyclic account of how photosynthetic organisms incorporate carbon and regenerate a carbon acceptor.

impact.note: A new understanding of carbon fixation held by plant scientists, from which later work on other fixation pathways and the fixing enzyme grew.

date.basis: Year of the dated publication, or a broad historian-estimated composition interval; no first discovery claimed.

events.statement: Six authors issued a Berkeley laboratory report in October 1953 describing cyclic regeneration of a carbon acceptor; the paper appeared in 1954.

evidence.supports: The 1953 report credits all six authors and describes the cyclic carbon assimilation account and sponsor.
